title: Minimum Bishop Moves to Reach Target
summary: On an empty eight-by-eight board, find the fewest bishop moves from source to target. Each move travels a positive distance along one diagonal while remaining on the board. Return -1 if unreachable.
officialConstraints: Coordinates use 1..8; source and target differ.
exampleStatus: Author and independently check examples; no source examples copied into public presets.
